mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), the Federal Reserve tightens policy to curb price pressures, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the prior month indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 2000 thousand units in a month, it signals residential sector weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST < 2000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During tight labor markets (UNRATE < 4.5%), wage pressures accelerate inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and unemployment rate increases signal economic contraction with manufacturing weakness and labor market deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
